Statewide KABCO only through CLEAR, which is gated to government staff and their consultants (FOIL otherwise).
No CLEAR-era export sample; reader built from ALIS-era exports; person-level export layout unseen.
Licence for paid use unclear for the NYSDOT marker layer, CLEAR exports and SAM address points.
DMV table stops at 2024 (2025 not posted as of 2026-11-07).
